function.description: This API returns the count of the instances of the configurations for an intended layer 2 feature on a wired device.
function.name: api_getNumberOfConfigurationsForAnIntendedLayer2FeatureOnADevice

feature.description: Name of the feature to configure. The API /intent/api/v1/networkDevices/{id}/configFeatures/supported/layer2 can be used to get the list of features supported on a device.

id.description: Network device ID of the wired device to configure.
